statement: ∀ (f : Space n → ℝ → Space m), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry f) (timeDomain n) → (∀ (x : Space n) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → dt f x t = fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (x,t) (0,1) ∧ ∀ j : Fin n, du f j x t = fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry f) (x,t) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1,0))
proof:
intro f hf x t ht
have ho : IsOpen (timeDomain n) := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_snd
have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry f) (x,t) := (hf (x,t) ht).contDiffAt (ho.mem_nhds ht)
have hd := hc.differentiableAt (by simp)
constructor
· have h := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t ((hasDerivAt_const t x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id t))
  exact h.deriv
· intro j
  have h := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp x ((hasFDerivAt_id x).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_const t x))
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y => f y t) x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) = _
  rw [h.fderiv]
  simp
